newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Contracts an issue at Australia Futures Week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Contracts an issue at Australia Futures Week.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said on Friday it would co-ordinate a working group, together with the United States and Britain, to look at contract design in the futures industry.
ASC chairman Alan Cameron said the ASC would report on aims to the regional futures regulators meeting in Sydney next week, to be held as part of Futures Week.
The meeting will be attended by regulators from the Asia Pacific region as well as from the U.S. and Britain.
The working party will look at contract design and the development of standards of best practice for the design and review of commodity futures contracts.
More than 300 financial market leaders from the Asia Pacific will attend the first Asia Pacific Futures Forum (APAC) in Sydney next week.
